audit.whatIsWrong: Level 6 read 'Skill' in both layers while whys[4] in the same matchup says 'Level 6 flips to Trundle' and the packet chart gives him that row.
audit.why: Subjugate steals health, armour and magic resist from 650 range and doubles the amount over four seconds — against a champion with no dash beyond a 300-unit Tumble, that is his one clearly winning stage. Every other row already agreed with the packet.
audit.corrected: Skill, Vayne, Vayne, Skill, Trundle, Vayne, Vayne — the level 6 row proposed as a matched full/content pair with its rating.

audit.whatIsWrong: The level 6 line was Final Hour boilerplate and gave no number for the ultimate that actually decides the stage.
audit.why: Subjugate is 120s at rank 1, so there is a long window between casts where his all-in is just autos plus Chomp. Final Hour at 100s gives bonus AD, a faster Tumble and invisible Tumbles, but it does not answer a percent-health steal landed in melee.
audit.corrected: Fight in Subjugate's 120s downtime; do not be in melee range when it is up.

audit.whatIsWrong: Pillar of Ice is treated purely as a wall to route around, and spikes[1] tells the player to Condemn 'mid-drain to break the channel'. Subjugate is not flagged as a channel anywhere in the kit.
audit.why: Pillar of Ice creates impassable terrain and Condemn stuns on any terrain collision — so the pillar he places is a free wall-stun for Vayne when it is on his side of the fight. The Condemn-cancels-Subjugate claim has no support; the verified value is the displacement out of his 650-unit steal range plus the stun if terrain is behind him. Chomp is also an auto-attack reset, so the wind-up is the tell, not the cast.
audit.corrected: His pillar is terrain — Condemn him into it. Read Chomp's reset wind-up as the step-back cue.
sources: kit: Pillar of Ice terrain flag

audit.whatIsWrong: Packet defect: no cooldown-sequencing advice anywhere.
audit.why: Pillar of Ice is 21s at rank 1 and is his only tool for cutting off a kite; without it he has no gap-closer at all.
audit.corrected: Commit once Pillar of Ice is spent — 21s at rank 1 and no dash.

edits.after: Subjugate steals your health and resistances from 650 units and doubles it over 4 seconds — never be in melee when it is up.

edits.before: Burning it for tiny value leaves you naked for its full cooldown.
edits.after: Frozen Domain boosts his attack speed and every heal he gets.

edits.before: Trundle's Subjugate (R) is the scary button: he drains a chunk of your max HP and armor, buffs himself huge, and it makes his all-in genuinely lethal if you're caught in melee. Hold your Final Hour and E to answer it — Condemn him mid-drain into a wall to break the channel range and reset the fight.
edits.after: Trundle's Subjugate (R) is the scary button: from 650 range it steals your health, armour and magic resist, then doubles the theft over 4 seconds, so his all-in is genuinely lethal in melee. It is 120 seconds at rank 1 — fight inside that gap, and Condemn him into terrain to break the range and reset.

notes: The best find, restated from the Trundle side: Pillar of Ice is impassable terrain and Condemn stuns on terrain collision, so a pillar dropped between you is a free wall-stun for Vayne rather than a pure liability. Removed the claim that Condemn breaks a Subjugate 'channel' — Subjugate carries no channel flag and Riot's text does not describe one. UNVERIFIED: whether Subjugate can be interrupted at all.
